idea-plugin.name: Vura
idea-plugin.description:
Adds support for the Vura programming language.
  • Coding assistance: Code completion, syntax highlighting, definition exploration and more
  • Build/Execution: Allows starting and building your Vura projects directly in the IDE
  • Error reporting: Reports build errors in the build console and shows them in the source files
  • Dependency management: Shows your installed libraries and lets you browse for new ones
Still early in development Language GitHub Plugin GitHub
